description: Toroidal DualMode ReuseB / ReuseA WITH the two-big-SRAM accumulator — low-M GEMV accumulated across K-passes in the AccSram instead of in software. In dual mode the accumulator's FREE output dimension is N (M is 1), so freeDimensionSize is the number of STREAM STEPS per K-pass and one resident panel spans freeDimensionSize * numPorts outputs; maxContractionSize is the largest K, i.e. contractionPasses = maxContractionSize / contractionPassDepth K-passes accumulate into each slot. freeDimensionSize is PROVISIONED HERE SO ONE PANEL COVERS THE WHOLE N of gemm_dual_acc.json (span 64): the stationary A slice is loaded once per (panel, K-pass), so a panel that spans all of N makes it once per K-pass and the whole N streams against each loaded slice. A smaller depth still runs — it just reloads A per panel — and a GEMM N below the span leaves the tail slots zero-padded.
